package observability

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"sync/atomic"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"example.com/asynctracing/internal/events"
	"example.com/asynctracing/internal/inspects"
	"example.com/asynctracing/internal/logger"
	"example.com/asynctracing/internal/queues"
	"example.com/asynctracing/internal/runtime"
	"github.com/goforj/queue"
	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/sdk/trace"
	collector "go.opentelemetry.io/proto/otlp/collector/trace/v1"
	tracepb "go.opentelemetry.io/proto/otlp/trace/v1"
	"google.golang.org/protobuf/proto"
)

// processTraceEvent crosses the transport boundary with a recognizable application payload.
type processTraceEvent struct{ ID string }

// Topic isolates the acceptance event from other generated examples.
func (processTraceEvent) Topic() string { return "acceptance.orders.finished" }

// processSpan retains collector resource identity alongside the exported span.
type processSpan struct {
	service string
	span    *tracepb.Span
}

// TestAsyncSeparateProcesses coordinates independent publisher, worker, and event consumer lifetimes.
func TestAsyncSeparateProcesses(t *testing.T) {
	var mu sync.Mutex
	var spans []processSpan
	receiver := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		body, err := io.ReadAll(r.Body)
		if err != nil {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), 400)
			return
		}
		var request collector.ExportTraceServiceRequest
		if err := proto.Unmarshal(body, &request); err != nil {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), 400)
			return
		}
		mu.Lock()
		defer mu.Unlock()
		for _, resource := range request.ResourceSpans {
			service := ""
			for _, attr := range resource.Resource.Attributes {
				if attr.Key == "service.name" {
					service = attr.Value.GetStringValue()
				}
			}
			for _, scope := range resource.ScopeSpans {
				for _, span := range scope.Spans {
					spans = append(spans, processSpan{service, span})
				}
			}
		}
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/x-protobuf")
	}))
	defer receiver.Close()
	dir := t.TempDir()
	executable, err := os.Executable()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 60*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	processes := map[string]*exec.Cmd{}
	outputs := map[string]*bytes.Buffer{}
	for _, role := range []string{"eventconsumer", "worker", "publisher"} {
		if role == "publisher" {
			processWait(t, func() bool { return processExists(dir, "worker.ready") && processExists(dir, "eventconsumer.ready") }, "role readiness")
			client := http.Client{Timeout: time.Second}
			processWait(t, func() bool {
				response, err := client.Get(os.Getenv("ASYNC_NATS_MONITOR") + "/varz")
				if err != nil {
					return false
				}
				defer response.Body.Close()
				var state struct {
					Subscriptions int `json:"subscriptions"`
				}
				return json.NewDecoder(response.Body).Decode(&state) == nil && state.Subscriptions >= 2
			}, "broker subscription registration")
		}
		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, executable, "-test.run=^TestAsyncProcessRole$", "-test.timeout=55s", "-test.v")
		env := []string{}
		for _, entry := range os.Environ() {
			if !strings.HasPrefix(entry, "OTEL_") && !strings.HasPrefix(entry, "LIGHTHOUSE_") {
				env = append(env, entry)
			}
		}
		cmd.Env = append(env, "ASYNC_PROCESS_ROLE="+role, "ASYNC_PROCESS_DIR="+dir, "OTEL_SERVICE_NAME=async-"+role, "OTEL_TRACES_EXPORTER=otlp", "OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER=always_on", "OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_PROTOCOL=http/protobuf", "OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_ENDPOINT="+receiver.URL+"/v1/traces", "LIGHTHOUSE_ENABLED=false", "LIGHTHOUSE_INSPECT_ENABLED=false")
		output := &bytes.Buffer{}
		cmd.Stdout = output
		cmd.Stderr = output
		if err := cmd.Start(); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		processes[role] = cmd
		outputs[role] = output
		t.Cleanup(func() {
			if cmd.ProcessState == nil {
				_ = cmd.Process.Kill()
				_ = cmd.Wait()
			}
		})
	}
	for _, role := range []string{"publisher", "worker", "eventconsumer"} {
		if err := processes[role].Wait(); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("%s: %v\n%s", role, err, outputs[role])
		}
		processWrite(t, dir, role+".exited", nil)
	}
	pids := map[string]bool{}
	for _, role := range []string{"publisher", "worker", "eventconsumer"} {
		body, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(dir, role+".pid"))
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		pid := string(body)
		if pids[pid] || pid == strconv.Itoa(os.Getpid()) {
			t.Fatalf("roles share process %s", pid)
		}
		pids[pid] = true
	}
	mu.Lock()
	defer mu.Unlock()
	byName := map[string][]processSpan{}
	for _, span := range spans {
		byName[span.span.Name] = append(byName[span.span.Name], span)
	}
	for name, count := range map[string]int{"POST /orders": 1, "send default": 1, "acceptance.orders.process": 2, "send acceptance.orders.finished": 1, "process acceptance.orders.finished": 1} {
		if len(byName[name]) != count {
			t.Fatalf("%s: got %d spans, want %d; collected=%v", name, len(byName[name]), count, spans)
		}
	}
	request := byName["POST /orders"][0]
	producer := byName["send default"][0]
	attempts := byName["acceptance.orders.process"]
	var failed, succeeded processSpan
	for _, attempt := range attempts {
		if attempt.span.Status.GetCode() == tracepb.Status_STATUS_CODE_ERROR {
			failed = attempt
		} else {
			succeeded = attempt
		}
	}
	if failed.span == nil || succeeded.span == nil {
		t.Fatal("retry must export one failed and one successful execution")
	}
	eventProducer := byName["send acceptance.orders.finished"][0]
	consumer := byName["process acceptance.orders.finished"][0]
	for _, edge := range [][2]processSpan{{request, producer}, {producer, failed}, {producer, succeeded}, {succeeded, eventProducer}, {eventProducer, consumer}} {
		if !bytes.Equal(edge[0].span.SpanId, edge[1].span.ParentSpanId) {
			t.Fatalf("parent mismatch: %s -> %s", edge[0].span.Name, edge[1].span.Name)
		}
	}
	for _, span := range spans {
		if !bytes.Equal(span.span.TraceId, request.span.TraceId) {
			t.Fatalf("split trace: %s", span.span.Name)
		}
	}
	for _, identity := range []struct {
		span    processSpan
		service string
	}{{request, "async-publisher"}, {producer, "async-publisher"}, {failed, "async-worker"}, {succeeded, "async-worker"}, {eventProducer, "async-worker"}, {consumer, "async-eventconsumer"}} {
		if identity.span.service != identity.service {
			t.Fatalf("%s service=%q", identity.span.span.Name, identity.span.service)
		}
	}
	body, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(dir, "handler.log"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var entry logger.LogEntry
	if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &entry); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if entry.Message != "order finished" || entry.Fields["trace_id"] != hex.EncodeToString(request.span.TraceId) || entry.Fields["span_id"] != hex.EncodeToString(consumer.span.SpanId) {
		t.Fatalf("handler log lost trace correlation: %s", body)
	}
}

// TestAsyncProcessRole runs exactly one generated application role without inherited telemetry state.
func TestAsyncProcessRole(t *testing.T) {
	role := os.Getenv("ASYNC_PROCESS_ROLE")
	if role == "" {
		t.Skip("subprocess fixture")
	}
	dir := os.Getenv("ASYNC_PROCESS_DIR")
	processWrite(t, dir, role+".pid", []byte(strconv.Itoa(os.Getpid())))
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 45*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	manager := inspects.NewManager()
	if err := manager.ConfigureTelemetry(ctx); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer func() {
		shutdown, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
		defer cancel()
		if err := manager.Shutdown(shutdown); err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
		}
	}()
	if role == "publisher" {
		jobs, err := queues.NewManagerWithObserver(nil, nil, manager)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		defer jobs.Default().Shutdown(context.Background())
		request := manager.Begin(ctx, runtime.SourceHTTP, "POST /orders", nil)
		_, err = jobs.WithContext(request).Dispatch(queue.NewJob("acceptance.orders.process").Payload(map[string]string{"id": "order-42"}).Retry(1))
		manager.Finish(request, "ok", nil)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		return
	}
	buses, err := events.NewManagerWithContext(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	buses.WithObserver(EventObserver(manager, nil))
	defer buses.Default().Close(context.Background())
	if role == "worker" {
		jobs, err := queues.NewManagerWithObserver(nil, nil, manager)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		var attempts atomic.Int32
		jobs.Register("acceptance.orders.process", func(jobContext context.Context, message queue.Message) error {
			if err := processBarrier(jobContext, dir, "publisher.exited"); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			var payload struct {
				ID string `json:"id"`
			}
			if err := message.Bind(&payload); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			if payload.ID != "order-42" {
				return errors.New("job payload lost")
			}
			if runtime.SourceFromContext(jobContext) != runtime.SourceJobs {
				return errors.New("job source lost")
			}
			if attempts.Add(1) == 1 {
				return errors.New("transient acceptance failure")
			}
			return buses.Default().WithContext(jobContext).Publish(processTraceEvent{ID: "order-42"})
		})
		if err := jobs.Default().StartWorkers(ctx); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		defer jobs.Default().Shutdown(context.Background())
		processWrite(t, dir, "worker.ready", nil)
		processWait(t, func() bool { return processExists(dir, "event.received") }, "event delivery")
		if attempts.Load() != 2 {
			t.Fatalf("attempts=%d", attempts.Load())
		}
		return
	}
	if role != "eventconsumer" {
		t.Fatalf("unknown role %q", role)
	}
	ended := &processCompletion{done: make(chan struct{})}
	manager.TracerProvider().RegisterSpanProcessor(ended)
	t.Setenv("APP_LOG_FORMAT", "json")
	appLogger := logger.NewAppLogger()
	var logMu sync.Mutex
	var logBody []byte
	appLogger.AddSink(func(entry logger.LogEntry) { logMu.Lock(); defer logMu.Unlock(); logBody, _ = json.Marshal(entry) })
	handled := make(chan error, 1)
	subscription, err := buses.Default().Subscribe(func(eventContext context.Context, event processTraceEvent) error {
		if event.ID != "order-42" || runtime.SourceFromContext(eventContext) != runtime.SourceEvents {
			err := fmt.Errorf("event payload or source lost: %+v", event)
			handled <- err
			return err
		}
		processWrite(t, dir, "event.received", nil)
		if err := processBarrier(eventContext, dir, "worker.exited"); err != nil {
			handled <- err
			return err
		}
		appLogger.WithContext(eventContext).Info().Msg("order finished")
		handled <- nil
		return nil
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer subscription.Close()
	processWrite(t, dir, "eventconsumer.ready", nil)
	select {
	case err := <-handled:
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	case <-ctx.Done():
		t.Fatal(ctx.Err())
	}
	select {
	case <-ended.done:
	case <-ctx.Done():
		t.Fatal(ctx.Err())
	}
	if err := subscription.Close(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	logMu.Lock()
	body := append([]byte(nil), logBody...)
	logMu.Unlock()
	processWrite(t, dir, "handler.log", body)
}

// processWait bounds coordination failures without assuming process or broker startup timing.
func processWait(t *testing.T, ready func() bool, label string) {
	t.Helper()
	deadline := time.Now().Add(30 * time.Second)
	for time.Now().Before(deadline) {
		if ready() {
			return
		}
		time.Sleep(20 * time.Millisecond)
	}
	t.Fatalf("timed out waiting for %s", label)
}

// processExists observes a barrier only after the originating process has published it.
func processExists(dir, name string) bool {
	_, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(dir, name))
	return err == nil
}

// processWrite atomically publishes evidence so readers cannot observe partial output.
func processWrite(t *testing.T, dir, name string, body []byte) {
	t.Helper()
	path := filepath.Join(dir, name)
	if err := os.WriteFile(path+".tmp", body, 0600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.Rename(path+".tmp", path); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

// processBarrier verifies downstream work can continue after its sending process has exited.
func processBarrier(ctx context.Context, dir, name string) error {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 30*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	ticker := time.NewTicker(20 * time.Millisecond)
	defer ticker.Stop()
	for {
		if processExists(dir, name) {
			return nil
		}
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			return fmt.Errorf("waiting for %s: %w", name, ctx.Err())
		case <-ticker.C:
		}
	}
}

// processCompletion synchronizes test shutdown with the fully ended event handler span.
type processCompletion struct {
	done chan struct{}
	once sync.Once
}

// OnStart leaves span construction to the configured telemetry provider.
func (*processCompletion) OnStart(context.Context, trace.ReadWriteSpan) {}

// OnEnd releases the role only after its instrumented callback has returned.
func (p *processCompletion) OnEnd(span trace.ReadOnlySpan) {
	if span.Name() == "process acceptance.orders.finished" {
		p.once.Do(func() { close(p.done) })
	}
}

// Shutdown requires no resource cleanup because export belongs to ConfigureTelemetry.
func (*processCompletion) Shutdown(context.Context) error { return nil }

// ForceFlush requires no work because this processor does not buffer spans.
func (*processCompletion) ForceFlush(context.Context) error { return nil }
